Trunk copies this folder to dist/three (see index.html). The app's own
3D view, apps/desktop-ui/js/view3d.js, loads it when a person first turns
3D on. It has its own small orbit control, so OrbitControls is not used.

To update: download the new release the same way, check its integrity,
copy the same files, change the same import lines, and update this note.
